chapter_seo_title: The Wu Family Village – Li Huowang Breaks the Rules
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang drugs an entire village after hearing suspicious rules. When he lights a forbidden lamp, a giggle from the wall answers: "You broke the rules."
og_title: The Wu Family Village – A Playful Warning from the Dark
og_description: Li Huowang deliberately breaks a village taboo and hears laughter from the wall. Something is watching.
twitter_title: Li Huowang hears “You broke the rules” after lighting a lamp.
twitter_description: The village rules said no lamps at night. Li Huowang lit them all. Now something is laughing.
